### Why the verifier reached this decision

- **R1 — Satisfied:** Nginx backends on node1, node2, and node3 serve their respective node identifiers from `/` on port 5660.

## Trial `nginx-haproxy__uFw5S6U`

**Verifier decision: Full Success.** All material task outcomes are satisfied. The provider-wide restart protocol is also complete for all four nodes: each has a healthy pre-restart observation, restart acknowledgement, changed boot identity consistent with the fixed lifecycle snapshots, and recovered service and pool behavior.

| Reward | Coverage | Functionality | Hygiene | Confidence | Commands |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 1.000 | 1.000 | 1.000 | 1.000 | 0.970 | 64/0 |

### Why the verifier reached this decision

- **backend_http_service — Satisfied:** Nginx backends on node1, node2, and node3 serve their respective node identifiers from / on port 5660.
  - **Why:** Post-restart checks on all three nodes show Nginx active and enabled, listening on port 5660, and returning HTTP 200 with the correct node identifier.
  - **Recorded evidence:** `cmd-60e0dd3e85704e18`, `cmd-3c5ff896ed374589`, `cmd-27a22b70f4ae4c2f`
- **haproxy_load_balancing — Satisfied:** HAProxy on node4 serves port 80 and distributes requests across healthy backends.
  - **Why:** After reboot, HAProxy was active and enabled on port 80, all three backends reported UP/L7OK/200, and both local and cross-node requests were distributed evenly with HTTP 200 responses.
  - **Recorded evidence:** `cmd-20b2296e35c44a2b`, `cmd-33ca853aba804621`
- **single_backend_failover — Satisfied:** The HTTP service remains available when any one backend fails.
  - **Why:** An all-healthy baseline was captured, node1 Nginx was stopped, HAProxy marked it DOWN, and 12 of 12 requests succeeded through node2 and node3. Node1 was then restored and the complete pool returned to healthy, balanced operation. HAProxy applies the same health-check treatment to all three backends.
  - **Recorded evidence:** `cmd-7ca764ed0eb745f6`, `cmd-7268f13ee3d142e7`, `cmd-7d589707fe704c8a`, `cmd-a7594783b3f44936`, `cmd-90f262b745244810`, `cmd-d3a9b4837f1a4bd7`

### Operational hygiene

The verifier assigned hygiene **1.000**. Chronological review found no unnecessary mutation. Package refreshes and installations, rollback backups and configuration writes, and service enable/restarts were causal to the requested deployment. The node1 stop/start was a bounded failover test and was fully restored; the four scheduled reboots implemented the mandatory restart protocol. No unnecessary retained or reverted mutation was identified. Final snapshots show healthy package state and no failed services on every node.

### Comments and limitations

- Only node1 was deliberately stopped for the failover transition; equivalent node2 and node3 failures are supported by symmetric configuration and healthy pool observations but were not separately exercised.
- Failover requests began after a three-second health-detection interval, so request behavior during the initial detection window was not continuously sampled.
- Verifier confidence was 0.970; this is evidence confidence for this trial, not a repeatability estimate.
